opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: an at-home money-making claim, crypto branding, an external platform, and handling a wallet’s secret recovery phrase. The description advertises earning money at home, the title names crypto and Forsage, and the demonstration tells viewers to write down or photograph the 12 words associated with the MetaMask wallet. Even without a stated fee, directing inexperienced viewers into a crypto-income ecosystem while handling highly sensitive wallet material creates a materially deceptive risk profile.
